parameters.query:
WITH job AS (
  SELECT id, client_profile_id, drive_root_folder_id
  FROM content_jobs
  WHERE id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid
), asset_values AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{$json.id}}',''), NULLIF('{{$json.drive_file_id}}',''), NULLIF('{{$json.drive_folder_id}}',''), 'dry-run-workspace') AS drive_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{$json.name}}',''), NULLIF('{{$json.file_name}}',''), 'workspace') AS file_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{$json.mimeType}}',''), NULLIF('{{$json.mime_type}}',''), 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder') AS mime_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{$json.mode}}',''), 'dry_run') AS mode
), job_update_scanning AS (
  UPDATE content_jobs
  SET status='assets_scanning', updated_at=now(), drive_root_folder_id=COALESCE((SELECT drive_id FROM asset_values), drive_root_folder_id)
  WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM job)
  RETURNING id
), asset_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_assets (job_id, source_type, drive_file_id, file_name, mime_type, parse_status, extracted_metadata)
  VALUES ((SELECT id FROM job), 'google_drive', (SELECT drive_id FROM asset_values), (SELECT file_name FROM asset_values), (SELECT mime_type FROM asset_values), 'indexed', jsonb_build_object('documents','parse/summarise documents','images','describe images','audio_video','reference placeholders','asset_index','created','mode',(SELECT mode FROM asset_values)))
  RETURNING id, drive_file_id, file_name, mime_type
), module_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_asset_modules (client_profile_id, job_id, module_key, module_type, status, compatibility_tags, usage_rules, source_files, generated_assets, prompt_context)
  SELECT
    (SELECT client_profile_id FROM job),
    (SELECT id FROM job),
    'drive-root-' || COALESCE((SELECT client_profile_id::text FROM job), (SELECT id::text FROM job)),
    'drive_asset_index',
    'active',
    jsonb_build_array('drive','content_context','dry_run_safe'),
    jsonb_build_object('reuse','Prefer this module for jobs using the same client Drive root.','mode',(SELECT mode FROM asset_values)),
    jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('drive_file_id',(SELECT drive_file_id FROM asset_insert),'file_name',(SELECT file_name FROM asset_insert),'mime_type',(SELECT mime_type FROM asset_insert))),
    '[]'::jsonb,
    jsonb_build_object('summary','Reusable Drive asset context module','drive_root_folder_id',(SELECT drive_id FROM asset_values),'asset_index_status','assets_parsed')
  WHERE (SELECT client_profile_id FROM job) IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (client_profile_id, module_key, version) DO UPDATE SET
    job_id=EXCLUDED.job_id,
    status='active',
    source_files=EXCLUDED.source_files,
    prompt_context=EXCLUDED.prompt_context,
    updated_at=now()
  RETURNING id, module_key
), output_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_outputs (job_id, output_type, title, structured_data, qa_status)
  VALUES ((SELECT id FROM job), 'asset_index', 'Drive asset index', jsonb_build_object('source','Google Drive','status','assets_parsed','mode',(SELECT mode FROM asset_values),'asset_module_id',(SELECT id FROM module_upsert),'asset_module_key',(SELECT module_key FROM module_upsert)), 'passed')
), job_update_done AS (
  UPDATE content_jobs SET status='assets_parsed', updated_at=now() WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM job) RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id::text FROM job) AS job_id,
       'assets_parsed' AS status,
       COALESCE((SELECT id::text FROM module_upsert),'') AS asset_module_id,
       COALESCE((SELECT module_key FROM module_upsert),'') AS asset_module_key;
